crossRefs.note: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat the scroll.
“Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them…
“Son of man, set your face toward the south, and preach toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the field…
Tell the forest of the South, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word: The Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, I will kindle a fire in you, and it…
“Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem, and preach toward the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel.
“Son of man, set your face toward the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them.
“Cry aloud! Don’t spare! Lift up your voice like a trumpet! Declare to my people their disobedience, and to the house…
Therefore I have cut them to pieces with the prophets; I killed them with the words of my mouth. Your judgments are…
“Put the trumpet to your lips! Something like an eagle is over Yahweh’s house, because they have broken my covenant…

translations.web: Therefore prophesy against them. Prophesy, son of man.”
translations.bsb: Therefore prophesy against them; prophesy, O son of man!”
translations.kjv: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man.
translations.asv: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man.
